//: APPEND-ONLY. One $id never names two byte sequences.
Validating fixtures against whatever schema is packed today cannot detect
that a later commit reused an identity for different bytes, so the mapping
is recorded here and asserted in CI. Preview identities may be superseded by
a new preview identity; they are never edited in place.
Digests are over the exact raw bytes of the file — no newline
normalization, no transcoding, no JSON canonicalization. A digest over the
same content reformatted pins nothing. Phase 6 asserts the repository bytes
and the packed-tarball bytes are the same bytes.
